finalAssessment: Clean installation, idempotent reinstall, consent-protected uninstall, native authentication/rendering and historical controlled recovery passed. The final core independently compiled and passed 21 SQL blocks, actual-export theme detection, exact exporter-comment normalization and cross-actor snapshot deduplication. The previously identified format and actor-fingerprint defects are resolved for these recorded bytes. SQLcl configuration retains a documented client limitation with a verified SQLPlus path. The later portable-sample phase also verified actual SQLPlus core installation twice, new manager/sample imports, exact saved-offset reuse, preserved component IDs, three non-destructive refusals and an actual ten-eligible/two-dropped comparison. The repository-root include-path issue is resolved for the recorded scripts. A later independent history-access phase compiled the latest six units, passed23 SQL blocks and20 new-app history tests, including absent/renamed target downloads, retained live denials, hash-valid wrong-identity rejection and exact owner restoration. These are phased working-tree results, not final-release certification.
